title: e2er event design
description: event_design.json: the machine-readable design of a financial event study, written by the identification strategist in templates that ask for it and read by the event_window check before estimation. Windows are in trading days relative to the event day 0, counted on `calendar`. See skills/files/econometrics/event-study.md.

calendar.description: The table and date column in the paper's data.db whose dates are the trading days.

events_source.description: The researcher's own event table in data.db. When declared, the design's event dates must be exactly this table's dates, each moved to the next trading day of `calendar` when it is not one (rule (d) of the event_window check).

date.description: Event day 0, a trading day of `calendar`.

asset.description: The asset or firm; absent means every asset of the study.
